lead.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half the price
lead.summary: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 Sol and Luna, building on GPT-6 Astra with faster inference, improved alignment, and 50% lower API prices versus GPT-5.6 promotional pricing. Sol targets complex coding at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens while Luna handles high-volume clerical work at $0.10/$0.50, both claiming half the factual error rate of their predecessors. Available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API.

top_stories.title: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu V900 AI accelerator, claims China's most powerful chip
top_stories.summary: Alibaba's T-Head unit unveiled the Zhenwu V900, delivering 3x the performance of its predecessor with 216GB memory and 1,200GB/s chip-to-chip interconnect, scalable to 500,000 units for frontier-model training. Mass production slated for Q1 2027 alongside 20GW global datacenter capacity by 2032.

top_stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 at 40% lower cost
top_stories.summary: Anthropic's new flagship performs at Fable 5.1 level on most tasks but costs 40% less to run than Opus 5, priced at $4/M input and $20/M output tokens with 30% faster generation and improved safety guardrails.

top_stories.title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as AI training data demand booms
top_stories.summary: Snorkel AI closed a $350M Series E at $3.5B valuation led by Insight Partners and S32, with 18x ARR growth to $375M driven by demand for AI training data and synthetic data for RL environments.

top_stories.title: Qualcomm launches Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 on 2nm with on-device AI
top_stories.summary: At Snapdragon Summit, Qualcomm unveiled two flagship mobile processors on 2nm: the 8 Elite Gen 6 and Gen 6 Pro Extreme. New sensing hubs run on-device AI models up to 200M parameters, and the Extreme runs 30B MoE models locally for voice-in/voice-out agents.

items.title: SpeakerMem-R1: speaker-centered dual-track memory for multi-party dialogue
items.summary: Long-term conversational memory that distinguishes who said what, whom each statement concerns, how individuals perceive one another, and how group-shared information changes over time.

items.title: PACT: from credit assignment to critic alignment for RL in LLMs
items.summary: Formalizes three regularity conditions (completeness, additivity, policy-consistency) bridging token-level credit assignment and critic alignment in reinforcement learning for language models.

items.title: You only need 2/3 of the chosen experts: dynamic expert pruning in fine-grained MoE LLMs
items.summary: Dynamic expert pruning achieves 33% throughput improvement with negligible quality drop, validated across fine-grained open-weight MoE architectures that routinely select many experts per token.

items.title: Toolcompass: guiding tool trialing, not suppressing it, for LLM agents
items.summary: Addresses the tool-trialing budget problem in LLM agents that must generalize to unseen tools at deployment, using outcome-based post-training guidance instead of brute suppression.

items.title: Ladders of Thought: self-evolving curriculum of simplified reasoning traces
items.summary: Improves small- and mid-scale LLM reasoning by combining progressive question simplification with self-evolving reasoning traces, addressing brittleness that persists even with knowledge distillation.

items.title: The Sirens' Song: when proximal background context overshadows distant evidence
items.summary: Identifies the Proximity Trap in long-context LLMs: insufficient attention to distant evidence arises less from distance than from cumulative competing background context.

items.title: Train where the quantized model goes: on-policy distillation for low-bit reasoning
items.summary: Proposes on-policy distillation to address repetitive degenerate loops in long generations that plague quantization-aware distillation below 3-bit precision.

items.title: NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 brings agentic AI to open source robotics
items.summary: Released at ROSCon 2026 in Toronto, Isaac ROS 5.0 introduces agentic workflows to the ROS ecosystem with expanded GPU-accelerated physical AI libraries across the Jetson platform, enabling robots to perceive, reason, and act in dynamic environments.

items.title: MIT's tiny flying robot gets 450% faster with new AI control system
items.summary: An AI control system lets a micro-aerial vehicle achieve insect-like agility, boosting speed by 450% and enabling 10 consecutive somersaults in 11 seconds, pushing the limits of micro-maneuverability.

items.title: AMD joins $1 trillion club as fourth US chipmaker on AI demand surge
items.summary: AMD's share price nearly tripled in 2026, driven by AI datacenter demand and the Meta Muse AI agent rally, making it the fourth US chipmaker to cross the trillion-dollar threshold after Nvidia, Broadcom, and TSMC.

items.title: Hello Robot shows Stretch 4 home-assistance robot at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: CEO Aaron Edsinger demonstrated the Stretch 4 on stage, showcasing physical AI for mobility-impaired users with a wheeled robot and telescoping arm targeting real-world utility over humanoid spectacle. First production run sold out.

items.title: JetBrains Air: agentic software development platform in public preview
items.summary: JetBrains launched Air, an open system connecting IDEs, team coordination, governance, and cost controls with multi-agent support including Codex, Claude Agent, Gemini CLI, and Junie.

items.title: Copperhead: open-source AI for PCB design from natural language
items.summary: An open-source AI engineering platform that designs, verifies, and documents circuit boards from natural-language prompts using KiCad integration, ERC validation, and decision logging. Hit #2 on HN.

items.title: DigitalOcean launches Managed Agents for production AI agent infrastructure
items.summary: DigitalOcean's new managed service integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and 16,000+ tools, with idle resource optimization for production AI agent workloads.

items.title: Tiledesk raises €1.1M for AI-powered business process automation
items.summary: The Italian open-source platform for creating AI agents and automating business processes closed a seed round from Zest, Vertis, and OpenT to accelerate natural-language process creation and digital sovereignty.

items.title: Gamindo secures €1.4M seed and launches AI training vertical
items.summary: The Italian corporate training startup raised from Club degli Investitori, Vento, Doorway, Zanichelli Venture, and angels including Bending Spoons co-founders and ex-Apple CFO Luca Maestri. Launched an AI training vertical for AI Act literacy compliance.
